about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
sentences: Mr. Speaker, in February, the Trump administration, in conjunction with the Israeli Government, launched an illegal and disastrous war in Iran.
Now, President Trump has threatened to use the United States military to carry out acts of genocide against the Iranian people, who are innocent civilians.
Mr. Speaker, I urge our colleagues to vote ``yes'' and that we end and stop all that is imperiled before us.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PERMISSION FOR MEMBER TO BE CONSIDERED AS FIRST SPONSOR OF H.R. 5658
statements.title: PERMISSION FOR MEMBER TO BE CONSIDERED AS FIRST SPONSOR OF H.R. 5658
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent that I may hereafter be considered to be the first sponsor of H.R. 5658, the Child Care for Every Community Act, a bill originally introduced by Representative Sherrill of New Jersey, for the purpose of adding cosponsors and requesting reprintings pursuant to clause 7 of rule XII.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGACY IMMIGRATION
statements.title: LEGACY IMMIGRATION
sentences: At every point, this administration has lied to us about ICE in America while some of the wealthiest actors in our country have tried to sell us a myth to defend it, including private prison contractors.
It is in the oligarchs taking $170 billion of our money from healthcare and food assistance and public programs and taking that and funneling it into a secret police program.
We are a country that has fought and defeated the Confederacy, that has defeated a history of civil rights violations, of secret police, and of fascism.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 5371, CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 5371, CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, God forbid that we have a Member of the Republican caucus who stands up and actually wants to extend the Affordable Care Act so that people with cancer, need insulin, and all sorts of healthcare issues across this country have their health insurance protected and extended throughout 2026.
Mr. Speaker, we cannot support it, and we cannot stand for it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CENSURED BUT NOT SILENCED
statements.title: CENSURED BUT NOT SILENCED
sentences: It is also the ABC corporation's responsibility to refuse to embolden and participate in this corruption and escalation of censorship.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, President Trump issued some statements throughout this process saying, urging, and insisting that this bill does not cut Medicaid.

The cap on that is $25,000, while you are jacking up taxes on people who make less than $50,000 across the United States, while taking away their SNAP, while taking away their Medicaid, and while kicking them off of the ACA and their healthcare extensions.
It explodes our national debt.
To give Elon Musk a tax break, and billionaires, the greedy, taking our Nation.
We cannot stand for it, and we will not support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: I want people at home to understand that Medicaid and the Federal matching funds for Medicaid can make up 30 to 40 percent of some of the State budgets that we have going on back home.
They are defunding Planned Parenthood.
They are ending tons of Medicaid coverage for 13.7 million Americans, including Affordable Care Act coverage, as well.
If Americans want to get an abortion and have a silver plan on a healthcare plan that they paid for, they will also be affected by this legislation, as well.

Mr. Speaker, I want people to understand, for my Republican colleagues who are sure what is in and not in this bill, in this process that has been this rushed, when they wake up in the morning, they will realize that they voted to defund Planned Parenthood and take away healthcare from 13.7 million Americans.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LAKEN RILEY ACT
statements.title: LAKEN RILEY ACT
sentences: We stand here just 2 days after President Trump gave unconditional pardons to violent criminals who attacked our Nation's Capitol on January 6, and these are the people who want us to believe that they are trying to keep criminals off the streets, when they are opening the floodgates.

If a person is so much as accused of a crime or if someone wants to point a finger and accuse someone of shoplifting, they will be rounded up and put into a private detention camp and sent out for deportation without a day in court, without a moment to assert their rights, and without a moment to assert the privilege of innocence until proven guilty.

Mr. Speaker, my colleagues may wonder why so many of our friends across the aisle, who care so deeply about the rule of law, happen to be so desperate to pass this bill after they are unleashing people who attacked police officers here in this Capitol and who are now free to roam our streets, who are publicly saying now that they want to get a gun.
Private prison companies are going to get flooded with money, who give this money, no doubt.
I want folks at home to look at which Members of Congress are invested in private prison companies, who receive this kind of money, and look at the votes on this bill.
It is atrocious that people are lining their pockets with private prison profits in the name of a horrific tragedy on the victim of a crime.
Mr. Speaker, when a private prison camp opens in your town and they say they didn't know this was going to happen, know that they did and that they voted for it.

When a Dreamer has disappeared from your classroom and when the President of the United States destroys what is left of the Constitution as he has announced in his attack on birthright citizenship, they will all say: We didn't know this was coming.
What is inside this bill is a fundamental suspension of a core American value, and that is why I rise to oppose it.
